title: New York City's property sales by year with their places, the subway's stations and the parks' properties: the records of a hedonic model of home prices
provider: NYC Department of Finance, NYC Citywide Annualized Calendar Sales Update (NYC Open Data w2pb-icbu); Metropolitan Transportation Authority, MTA Subway Stations (data.ny.gov 39hk-dx4f); NYC Department of Parks and Recreation, Parks Properties (NYC Open Data enfh-gkve)
credit: Sales: NYC Department of Finance; subway stations: MTA (data.ny.gov); parks: NYC Parks; all through NYC's and New York State's open data
licence: NYC Open Data's Terms of Use and data.ny.gov's Terms of Use; the datasets' licence fields are empty (checked 2026-11-09), and New York City's Open Data Law (Local Law 11 of 2012) publishes its datasets without restrictions on their use.
citation: NYC Department of Finance (2026), NYC Citywide Annualized Calendar Sales Update, https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/w2pb-icbu; MTA (2025), MTA Subway Stations, https://data.ny.gov/d/39hk-dx4f; NYC Parks (2026), Parks Properties, https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/enfh-gkve
format: brooklyn-2025.json: every 2025 sale in Brooklyn of building class categories 01–03 above $100,000, the portal's fields (sale_price, sale_date, gross_square_feet and land_square_feet as text with commas, year_built, building_class_category, latitude, longitude, …). subway-stations.json: the stations (gtfs_latitude, gtfs_longitude, …). parks-brooklyn.geojson: Brooklyn's park properties of 2.47 acres or more, with their outlines.
coverage: 5,535 sales; 5,473 kept by data/products/home_prices.py (a floor area, a year built, a price at least a tenth of the median). 496 station records citywide. 103 park properties of 1 hectare or more.

brooklyn.description: The subway's stations and Brooklyn's parks; the year's sales are fetched by data/products/home_prices.py
